name: Barrel Files Are Re-Exports Only
description: index.ts files should contain only re-export statements, no logic.
purpose: Barrel files stay pure pass-throughs so imports do not pull in side effects or hide implementation.
implementation: Use only `export { ... } from '...'` or `export * from '...'` statements in index.ts files. Move any logic, local declarations, or direct imports to non-index source files.
